'''Rakatan Base Prime''' was the primary command base of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] during their [[Invasion of the Tython system|invasion]]. Located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ska Gora]], the base was constructed after the planet was [[Fall of Ska Gora|captured]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]].
